display.purpose: The month in words (`maio de 2026`). Steps to 1.75rem below 768px; the token itself is the larger size.

title.purpose: A section heading, sitting on a ruling underline.

body.purpose: Sentences and secondary buttons. Prose stays within a 72-character measure.

label.purpose: The history, payee, or account name on a row, and the visible label of a field.

button.purpose: Primary actions and the stamp. Secondary buttons stay at body weight.

meta.purpose: Filenames, coordinates, the month-folder slug, document kind, in soft ink.

amount.purpose: Right-aligned money, tabular figures. Dates on a row use the same tabular figures at body weight.

chave.purpose: The 44-digit access key only, in IBM Plex Mono, shown as eleven groups of four.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Navigation wraps under the organization name below this width.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Wide gutter, ruled ledger sheets (head and body share one column template), two-column forms, and the people list begin here. Display type is the token size from this width; below it, 1.75rem.

narrative.overview:
The interface is a well-kept Brazilian cash book. The page is cool ledger paper. Every list of money is a ruled row: date, history, amount, status, with figures in tabular numbers and the amount on the right. The only loud device is the red margin. It marks a payment that still lacks a document, and an error. A month page with no red is ready to close.

Density follows the coordinator's laptop ritual. One left-aligned column, sections separated by a rule, status always visible, and the form that changes a row folded into a disclosure the person opens. The submitter's phone uses the same tokens, stacked. Nothing is a card. Nothing floats.

The closed month is an ink stamp, the only double-ruled mark in the system. The app mark repeats the same three strokes — a green field, two paper rules, one red margin — and carries no wordmark. When no organization is focused, the header reads the product name in the same medium weight as an organization name.
keyCharacteristics: **Ruled rows.** Record lists are a ledger sheet: vertical and horizontal rules, not cards.
**One red margin.** Red appears only on a missing document or an error.
**Flat paper.** Depth is a hairline rule, not a shadow.
**The stamp.** A closed month is inked and double-ruled. Nothing else is boxed.
**One type family.** IBM Plex Sans for the book; IBM Plex Mono only for the access key.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: `margem` marks a payment with a missing document and an error. A month page with no red is ready to close.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, and headings stay in sentence case. No all-caps, no eyebrow, no letterspaced small caps.

rules.name: The Chave Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only on the access key.

rules.name: The Ledger Column Rule
rules.body: Every record list is a ruled sheet with aligned columns, vertical rules, and tabular figures. The amount is right-aligned. Status and each action occupy their own columns.

rules.name: The Shared Track Rule
rules.body: Head and body of a sheet use the same column template. Action tracks are fixed rem, never `auto` or `max-content`: the header cell is empty, and a content-sized track would let the row drift off the rule.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat. Depth is the ruling line and the red margin.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: The only boxed mark is the closed-month stamp. Its double rule is the whole treatment.

rules.name: The Four Pixel Rule
rules.body: Controls, fields, and disclosure panels share one small corner. The page itself stays square.

dos: **Do** set a missing-document row and an error notice with a 3px left border in `margem` and 12px of inset.
**Do** fill a primary action with `caixa`, a sheet-white label, weight 600, and 8px by 16px padding.
**Do** separate sections with a ruling line under the heading, and draw each record list as one flat ruled sheet with vertical rules between cells.
**Do** keep payment rows denser than other lists, with Status and Ações as separate columns.
**Do** give the header row and every data row of a sheet the same column template; size action tracks in rem, not auto.
**Do** self-host IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono. The page makes no third-party font request.
**Do** draw focus as a 2px solid `caixa` ring, offset 2px, on every control.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second red, a shadow, a gradient, or an icon besides the app mark.
**Don't** put a record in a card. Column alignment is how the book is scanned.
**Don't** set a heading in all caps, small caps, or a serif display.
**Don't** tint the page warm cream. The paper is the cool ledger gray-green.
**Don't** disable the close action to hide a reason. The reason is a `margem` sentence.
**Don't** add motion the person did not trigger. Opening a disclosure is the only state change.
